title: eludite.agents.sessions output
description: The Agents window's sessions, newest first (by `last_activity`), and the one the window shows.

current.description: The id of the session the window shows; null when it shows none (as at startup).

id.description: Eludite's own id for the session (a UUID v4), for eludite.agents.switch's `session`.

agent.description: The name of the agent that owns it, as the registry names it.

title.description: The first prompt's first 60 characters on one line; `New session` until a prompt is sent.

started.description: When the session was started (RFC 3339, UTC).

last_activity.description: When the session last changed: a prompt, a turn's end, a permission answered (RFC 3339, UTC).

model.description: The model's name as the model picker last showed it, when the agent offers one.

waiting.description: A permission request of the session waits for an answer (answered after switching to it).
